question: Who was appointed as the Executive Director of Foods at Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL) in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajneet Kohli**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
__ 

• **Rajneet Kohli** was appointed as the **Executive Director of Foods** at Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL) in **March 2025**. 

• **Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL)** is one of India’s largest fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) companies, and the Foods category is a significant segment of its business operations. 

• Rajneet Kohli is a seasoned professional with years of experience in the FMCG sector, having held leadership positions in reputed organizations before joining HUL. 

• The appointment of Kohli is part of HUL’s strategic focus on strengthening its food business, which includes brands in segments like packaged foods, beverages, and culinary products. 

• This development aligns with HUL’s plans to enhance its market share and expand its footprint in the rapidly growing Indian packaged food industry. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
__ 

• **Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL):** 
 

• HUL is an Indian subsidiary of the British company **Unilever**, which has a legacy of over 80 years in the Indian market. 

• The company operates in various sectors, including personal care, home care, and foods & beverages. 

• HUL’s popular food brands include **Kissan, Knorr, Brooke Bond, and Lipton**, among others. 

• The Foods and Refreshments segment contributes significantly to HUL’s overall revenue and growth in the Indian market. 
 
 

• **Rajneet Kohli’s Professional Background:** 
 

• Rajneet Kohli has extensive experience in managing brands and driving growth in the consumer goods industry. 

• He has held senior management roles, contributing to product innovation, strategic planning, and market expansion in the FMCG domain. 
 
 

• **Indian Packaged Food Industry:** 
 

• The Indian packaged food market is rapidly growing, driven by changing lifestyles, urbanization, and increasing health-consciousness among consumers. 

• By 2025, the Indian packaged food market is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of around **10-12%**. 

• Major players in this market include **HUL, Nestle, ITC, Britannia, and Parle Products**. 
 
 

• **HUL’s Strategy for Growth:** 
 

• HUL is focusing on strengthening its premium product portfolio, including health and wellness products, to cater to a growing consumer base. 

• Investments in R&D and marketing are being ramped up to maintain HUL’s competitive edge in the food and beverage sector. 

• HUL’s commitment to sustainable business practices has further enhanced its reputation in the market. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
 

• **Leadership in the Indian FMCG Sector:** 
 

• HUL has consistently been a market leader in the FMCG sector in India, leveraging its strong distribution network and innovative product portfolio. 

• Appointments like that of Rajneet Kohli aim to further solidify HUL’s position in the highly competitive food category. 

• HUL’s focus on consumer-centric solutions and sustainable practices sets it apart in the industry. 
 
 

• **FMCG Industry in India:** 
 

• The Indian FMCG market is projected to grow at a CAGR of around **14%** during the 2022-2027 period, driven by increasing disposable incomes and demand for high-quality products. 

• Food and beverages account for a significant share of the FMCG market, with companies introducing innovative and health-focused products to meet consumer preferences.
